scene.title: MORNING RECIPE FLOW
scene.purpose: Emulate the exact 'Domestic Golden Slat' aesthetic from the ChatGPT commercial: warm morning sun slicing through wooden window blinds, terracotta textures, and unforced domestic sanctuary.
scene.emotional_destination: Peaceful domesticity, creative culinary focus, effortless presence.
scene.dominant_visual_idea: Young woman in a patterned green bandana holding an orange phone while stirring a steaming stockpot in golden morning sun slats.

important_generation_architecture.reason: Keep human hands, cookware contact, and window blind shadow geometry grounded and persistent without shape warping.
important_generation_architecture.generative_boundaries: Generate live-action human cooking and natural lighting through LTX-2.3. Composite screen UI and brand typography in post-production.

character.identity: Young woman (mid-20s) with brunette hair tied in a green patterned cotton bandana
character.wardrobe: Over-sized blue-and-white vertical striped cotton button-down shirt over a neutral tank top, medium-wash denim jeans
character.performance: Grounded, relaxed, natural unhurried arm movement stirring the pot, quiet focused expression

environment.location: Sunlit European apartment kitchen with glazed terracotta tile walls and window facing lush garden trees
environment.furniture: Vintage white gas stove, stainless steel sink basin, warm horizontal wooden venetian blinds
environment.props: Polished stainless steel stockpot with rising steam, red vintage metal colander in sink, warm ceramic tea canister on window ledge, orange smartphone held casually in hand

spatial_blocking.foreground: Stainless steel sink drainer and red vintage colander occupying the lower left foreground
spatial_blocking.midground: The woman standing beside the white stove, left hand holding the wooden spoon in the pot, right hand holding the phone at chest height
spatial_blocking.background: Large sunlit window with horizontal wooden blinds casting crisp shadow stripes on the wall, lush green leaves visible outside
spatial_blocking.camera_relation: Eye-level medium shot at 1.3m height, 2.2m distance looking across the kitchen counter

action_timeline.action: The woman gently rotates the wooden spoon in the simmering stockpot, her eyes scanning the warm orange smartphone in her right hand.
Delicate ribbons of culinary steam drift upward through the sunbeam; she lifts the spoon slightly, smiles faintly in culinary realization, and pauses.

performance.micro_actions: Slow wrist rotation, quiet blink, subtle lip relaxation, steam rising across face

camera.camera_type: Full-frame cinema camera on fluid tripod head
camera.starting_position: Medium interior framing capturing counter, subject, and window blinds
camera.depth_of_field: Medium depth of field (f/4.0) keeping cookware, subject, and blind slats sharp while garden outside softens
camera.focus_priority: Subject's face and the steaming stockpot

movement.00:12-00:15: Steady observational hold with subtle organic human breathing
movement.00:15-00:18: Gentle lateral track of 0.2m to the left, slightly expanding the golden sunbeam pattern on the tiled wall

visual_callback.thematic_motif: The golden horizontal light slats turning a simple kitchen routine into a sacred morning ritual.
visual_callback.color_harmony: Warm terracotta earth tones energized by the bold orange phone and emerald green bandana.

lighting.source: Direct morning sunlight streaming through wooden venetian window blinds at a 45-degree angle
lighting.quality: Crisp directional sunlight projecting sharp horizontal linear slat shadows, balanced by soft warm bounce from terracotta tiles
lighting.temperature: 3200K-3500K warm morning sunlight mixed with soft 5600K ambient daylight
lighting.direction: Side-back light from camera right, wrapping around subject's face and illuminating culinary steam
lighting.subject_lighting: Golden rim light along jawline, arm, and striped shirt; warm transparent fill across cheekbones
lighting.background_lighting: Alternating golden sun stripes and soft warm shadows across the glazed wall tiles
lighting.important_rule: Shadow slats on the wall and counter must remain sharp and geometrically motivated by the window blinds.

color_and_finish.style: Candid warm cinematic editorial realism (Miles Jay / ChatGPT aesthetic)
color_and_finish.film_character: Kodak Portra 400 warm 35mm celluloid film response
color_and_finish.grade: Kodak 2383 Print LUT with warm sepia lifted shadows, creamy skin tones, and rich earthy terracotta
color_and_finish.contrast: Gentle filmic S-curve with lifted, breathable shadow toe
color_and_finish.saturation: Naturalistic warm saturation with an isolated saturated accent on the orange phone
color_and_finish.grain: Fine 35mm organic celluloid grain structure with subtle gate texture
color_and_finish.halation: Delicate golden-red halation blooming softly around the bright window trim and chrome cookware specular glints
color_and_finish.texture: Glazed ceramic tile grout, stainless steel brush lines, coarse cotton bandana weave, rising steam ribbons, natural skin pores

audio.acoustics_and_ambience: Dry, warm domestic kitchen acoustics with subtle distant morning birdsong outside the open window.

00:12.0-00:14.5: soft wooden spoon scraping stainless steel bottom
00:14.5-00:18.0: quiet human inhalation of culinary aroma

music.entry: Subtle, intimate acoustic felt piano chord enters at 00:13.5
music.intensity: Low background bed (-18dB under room tone)
music.progression: Sustaining softly into the scene transition

ltx_2_3_prompt: In a sunlit European apartment kitchen with glazed terracotta wall tiles and a vintage white stove, a 25-year-old woman wearing a green patterned cotton bandana and an oversized blue-striped shirt gently stirs a simmering stainless steel stockpot with a wooden spoon while casually holding a bright coral-orange smartphone in her other hand. Golden 3400K morning sunlight streams through wooden venetian window blinds at a 45-degree angle, casting sharp, beautiful horizontal slat shadows across the tiled wall and countertop while illuminating delicate ribbons of steam rising from the pot into the warm air. The camera frames her in an intimate 35mm cinema prime medium shot at 1.3m eye level, holding a tranquil observational stance before executing an ultra-subtle 0.2-meter lateral tracking glide that smoothly preserves the level horizon and sharp slat shadow geometry. Warm Kodak Portra 400 35mm celluloid film response renders creamy skin highlights, lifted sepia shadows, fine organic grain, and soft golden halation around the window frame, capturing tactile textures of glazed ceramic tile, polished steel, and cotton weave, accompanied by the gentle sound of simmering soup, soft wooden spoon stirs, and an understated felt piano melody under quiet domestic room tone.

comfyui_direction.why_mode: Text-to-video implementation of the Miles Jay / ChatGPT 'Domestic Golden Slat' aesthetic.
comfyui_direction.camera_strategy: Precision fluid tripod hold + 0.2m micro-dolly at 0.07 m/s.
comfyui_direction.audio: Joint audio-visual latent pass generating synchronized liquid simmering, wooden spoon stirs, and felt piano bed.
comfyui_direction.prompting: Emphasize motivated window slat shadow lines, terracotta warmth, and steam dynamics.

render_strategy.pass_1_base: 640x360 @ 30 FPS, 181 frames (6s * 30 + 1), Euler sampler with 8-step ManualSigmas.

generation_priority: 1. Preserve sharp horizontal window blind shadow slat geometry across the terracotta tiles.
2. Grounded natural hand movement stirring the pot without finger distortion.
3. Organic 35mm Kodak Portra 400 warmth with lifted shadows and delicate halation.
4. Fluid rising steam physics interacting with morning sunbeams.
5. Precise audio synchronization of simmering broth and wooden spoon contact.

quality_control.critical_story_test: Audience must feel a tranquil, peaceful morning culinary flow state.
quality_control.critical_continuity_test: Bandana pattern, striped shirt, and terracotta tile color must remain rock-solid across all frames.
quality_control.critical_performance_test: Action must feel relaxed and unperformed, avoiding theatrical cooking gestures.
quality_control.critical_camera_test: Camera movement must remain subtle and level without sudden digital acceleration.
failure_conditions: shadow slats on wall flicker or warp
hand holding phone morphs into pot
steam looks like solid white geometry
